baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening z-ʿ-m claim is answered by a commanded q-w-l utterance, an oath by the Lord, and two emphatic passives.
baseline_models.mechanism: The denial enters as a report shadowed by uncertainty, while the reply is an authorized public utterance secured by sovereign oath. The verse establishes unequal speech authority before stating the event.

activation_trace.role: A report made without certainty supplies the denial's unstable speech status.
Articulated speech supplies the commanded public counter-utterance.
Sovereign ownership gives the oath authority over the event it guarantees.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply rebuts a false proposition about resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages two unequal speech acts: a precarious collective claim is displaced by commissioned, sworn, emphatic counter-speech.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The b-ʿ-th passive occurs twice before thumma introduces notification of intended acts.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated root can arouse what is still and dispatch what has been raised. Followed by notification, it makes resurrection both reanimation and mustering into an evidentiary sequence rather than a bare return to life.

activation_trace.role: Arousing the motionless supplies bodily emergence from settled stillness.
Dispatch toward an assigned destination turns revival into a mustering for encounter.
A consequential report supplies the destination of the mustering: disclosed knowledge.
Purposive action supplies the report's accountable content.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection is a single event followed by a verbal recap.
changed_reading.after: Those raised are also mobilized through a staged audit whose terminus is confrontation with their purposive acts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The k-f-r subject stands inside a sequence of arousing and making deeds reportable.
baseline_models.mechanism: The covering image in disbelief is reversed twice: settled bodies are stirred and what agents did becomes transmissible report. Denial is therefore not only a label but an attempted closure that the verse opens.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the deniers' attempt to keep the future event out of view.
Stirring what lies still reverses closure at the level of bodies.
Delivered report reverses closure at the level of deeds and knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The opening verb merely identifies the opponents as unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: Their unbelief performs concealment, and the raise-and-report sequence systematically defeats that concealment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final y-s-r predicate evaluates the entire sworn raising and notification sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ease includes readiness and opened possibility after obstruction, while lordship includes tending a process to completion. The ending therefore presents the whole sequence as prepared and governable, not merely as requiring little exertion.

activation_trace.role: Readiness and opened ease make the complete operation available despite imagined obstruction.
Tending and completing a process supplies the governing agency behind that readiness.
Arousal from stillness names the apparent obstruction that readiness overcomes.

changed_reading.before: Easy means only that resurrection costs God little effort.
changed_reading.after: The entire raise-and-disclose process is already open, prepared, and completable under divine governance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal dominion and effective capacity precede the focus, while prior human formation is paired with a destination toward God. The final ease becomes continuity within an already governed creation rather than an isolated exception to it.

activation_trace.role: Prepared ease anchors the focus claim that no obstruction closes the process.
Sovereign dominion supplies control over the field in which raising occurs.
Effective capability supplies the power to bring the denied event about.
Giving determinate form supplies a material precedent for embodied restoration.
Becoming toward an endpoint supplies direction to the later raising.

structural_cues: 64:1 places dominion and all-capacity before the denial; 64:3 places perfected formation beside the destination to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereign capacity, prior formation, and destination; I supply the arrow that first formation is a material precedent for re-raising. A live alternative is authority and moral teleology without a process analogy.

changed_reading.before: The final ease is an unsupported assertion of miraculous power.
changed_reading.after: Re-raising is one more directed transformation inside a creation already owned, formed, and moving toward its appointed destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Deeds are already seen, concealed and declared material is already known, and the unit closes with the unseen and witnessed held together. Notification therefore transfers hidden acts into the subjects' witnessed awareness or formal record; it does not supply missing information to God.

activation_trace.role: A consequential communicated report anchors the focus act of notification.
Inner sight makes deeds already apprehended before the later notification.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower establishes prior divine apprehension.
Concealment in the interior supplies the hidden side of what will be exposed.
Manifest declaration supplies the visible pole toward which notification moves.
What is screened from sight supplies the report's concealed domain.
Presence with witnessing supplies the report's destination in manifest evidence.

structural_cues: 64:2 attaches sight to deeds, 64:4 balances concealed and declared acts, and 64:18 closes with the unseen/witnessed pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior sight, knowledge, concealment, declaration, and witnessing; I assign notification toward the humans as disclosure. Live alternatives are formal accusation and experiential realization, which may coexist.

changed_reading.before: After resurrection God compiles or learns what people did and tells them.
changed_reading.after: Already-known hidden acts are made witnessed to their agents as evidence, accusation, or realization.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier deniers have become a report arriving to a later audience, and that report is paired with their tasting the heavy outcome of their affair. Rejection of human carriers of clarified messages then immediately precedes the focus denial. Future notification can thus be both role reversal and experienced verification.

activation_trace.role: Consequential report anchors the promised notification.
News about former deniers makes rejecters themselves into transmissible evidence.
Experiential testing makes the report felt rather than merely heard.
Harmful weight supplies the consequence that verifies the report.
Message-bearing envoys supply the mediation the deniers had rejected.
Clarifying disclosure removes lack of explanation as the cause of rejection.

structural_cues: 64:5 moves from received news to tasted consequence; 64:6 explains the refusal of messengers immediately before 64:7 repeats denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, tasted weight, and rejected mediation; I infer that the focus notification inherits experiential force and reverses reporter and reported. The live alternative is a warning analogy with no semantic carryover.

changed_reading.before: Notification is a neutral verbal recap after revival.
changed_reading.after: Those who reject transmitted evidence become reportable cases and are made to experience the weight that verifies the report.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch of z-ʿ-m supplies leadership or speaking for a group, while the singular command commissions a counter-speaker. The surrounding messenger passages define that counter-speech as clear delivery with bounded responsibility, turning the focus into a contest between collective representation and authorized relay.

activation_trace.role: Speaking or standing for a group gives the plural deniers a collective voice.
Publicly articulated speech supplies the commissioned counter-voice.
The messenger role supplies authorized human mediation before the focus command.
Repeated messenger reference preserves the relay role after the focus.
Delivery to the destination bounds the counter-speaker's task.
Clarifying expression defines the quality of the commissioned relay.

structural_cues: The plural claim in 64:7 is met by a singular imperative; 64:6 and 64:12 bracket it with rejected and duty-bound messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a collective subject, a singular speech command, and messenger-delivery language; I assign representative roles to the two sides. A live alternative is an ordinary proposition-and-rebuttal exchange.

changed_reading.before: The focus records an abstract disagreement between two propositions.
changed_reading.after: The focus stages rival social voices: a group-backed claim confronts a commissioned relay whose duty is delivery rather than successful persuasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus reverses human covering through report, but the same k-f-r inventory later supplies divine covering of wrongs, followed by entry into a screened garden; pardon, graceful turning aside, and protective forgiveness reinforce that endpoint. Accountability is not simply irreversible exposure.

activation_trace.role: Human covering anchors the concealment that notification first defeats.
Delivered report supplies the phase of accountable disclosure.
Covering a fault until it is as if unperformed supplies a merciful second covering.
A garden screened by growth supplies protected enclosure after judgment.
Leaving punishment and erasing fault supplies release after recognition.
Graceful turning away from fault supplies non-retention of the exposed offense.
Protective covering of fault supplies preservation from its continuing effect.

structural_cues: The k-f-r root changes actor and function between 64:7 and 64:9; 64:14 then accumulates three distinct responses to an acknowledged offense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human covering, divine expiation, protected enclosure, and pardon; I infer a disclose-then-recover arc. A live alternative is that mercy applies to a separate class without qualifying the focus notification itself.

changed_reading.before: Being informed of deeds means permanent and total exposure.
changed_reading.after: Deeds become answerable and witnessed, yet the same accountability process can terminate in erased consequence and protective re-covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, gathering exposes loss in exchange, reward appears as compensation, held wealth is sent out, and a cut portion is returned multiplied. The branch of ʿ-m-l as dealings lets notification read as settlement of relational transfers and hidden imbalance, not only enumeration of isolated acts.

activation_trace.role: Dealings between people make accountable action relational and transactional.
Consequential report supplies the statement by which the account is disclosed.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the common forum for settlement.
Hidden deprivation in a dealing supplies the imbalance made visible at gathering.
Compensation for work supplies a payable return on action.
Money going out supplies transfer away from possessive closure.
Eager withholding supplies the blocked flow against which spending is measured.
A cut portion of wealth or work given for return supplies the account's outgoing principal.
Increase by a corresponding multiple supplies transformed return rather than simple restoration.

structural_cues: After 64:7, transactional vocabulary accumulates through loss, reward, spending, withholding, lending, and multiplication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dealings, gathering, unequal exchange, compensation, outflow, withholding, loan, and multiplication; I map the notification onto an account settlement. A live alternative is a cluster of moral metaphors with no single ledger mechanism.

changed_reading.before: People receive a flat list of individually completed deeds.
changed_reading.after: They receive a settlement statement exposing how purposive dealings moved value, withheld it, harmed others, or returned with transformed consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the syntax fixes the word at index 7 as a q-w-l imperative and the oath noun as Lord; the ascent activation comes from the packet's non-dominant q-l-l and r-b-w mappings. It remains anchored in those focus words beside repeated b-ʿ-th, but downstream prose must render it only as branch or sound resonance, never as replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The command and oath frame the first emphatic promise of raising.

activation_trace.role: The split target's carrying and rising sense lets the counter-utterance echo the lift it announces.
The split target's increase and elevation sense makes the oath-name resonate with ascent.
Arousal from stillness keeps both split resonances attached to the explicit raising.

changed_reading.before: The command and oath only frame the proposition that follows.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch resonance, the verbal frame itself rises and lifts, formally enacting the resurrection it announces.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ordinary syntax requires 'claimed,' while guarantee and covenant are remote branches. It remains anchored in z-ʿ-m, the absolute 'never,' and the rival sworn Lord-formula; render it as a social-legal metaphor for attempted certainty, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The deniers attach an absolute negative future to z-ʿ-m, and the reply answers with an oath.

activation_trace.role: Surety and guarantee recast the absolute denial as an attempt to underwrite 'never.'
Pledge and covenant supply a rival guarantor structure inside the sworn reply.
The ordered utterance publicly replaces the attempted human guarantee.

changed_reading.before: The deniers offer an unsupported prediction that is contradicted.
changed_reading.after: They attempt to guarantee a future non-event, but their counterfeit surety is displaced by a sovereign oath that guarantees the opposite.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because neither Lord nor easy denotes gaming in the focus syntax. It remains doubly anchored in packet branches for r-b-b and y-s-r, with later gathering and unequal loss making a coherent allocation image; downstream prose must mark it as a material analogy for apportioned outcomes, never as direct exegesis or gambling imagery attributed to the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The oath by the Lord and the final ease enclose repeated mustering and disclosure of deeds.

activation_trace.role: A receptacle gathering lots supplies a collected set awaiting allocation.
Division by lots supplies apportionment into differentiated shares.
Dispatch and mustering supply the participants brought into the allocation scene.
Later gathering keeps the material analogy tied to the surah's actual sequence.
Unequal loss in dealings supplies differentiated stakes and outcomes.

changed_reading.before: All are raised and individually told the same kind of information.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the mustered whole is gathered for disclosure and differentiated apportionment according to what each has done.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the grammatical force of y-s-r remains ease and its subject remains the raise-and-report sequence. The smallness branch becomes live only through the later sufficiency-with-little and multiplication branches; render the result as a scale analogy, not an alternate parse of 64:7.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final y-s-r predicate measures the divine scale of the complete operation.

activation_trace.role: Small quantity supplies the latent scale reading inside the final predicate.
Sufficiency with little and visible effect makes small input consequential.
Increase by a matching multiple supplies expansion from slight input to large return.
A portion given for return supplies the small human input that can be amplified.

changed_reading.before: The ending only denies that total resurrection is difficult for God.
changed_reading.after: As a scale analogy, what is slight at divine scale can encompass total raising, while slight human outlay can become visibly multiplied consequence.

strongest_changes: Resurrection became a mustering into disclosure rather than a bare return to life.
Notification became human-facing witnessing of already-known hidden acts, with experiential and judicial readings still live.
The covering mechanism became reversible twice: human concealment is exposed, yet accountable fault may later receive protective re-covering.
Post-focus exchange language activated a settlement reading of deeds, including hidden loss, withheld flow, return, and multiplication.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supported several mechanisms without forced merger: unequal speech authority, arousal plus dispatch, concealment plus disclosure, process readiness, and transactional settlement. Split mapped roots made the command and oath resonate with ascent, while distant paired branches produced contained guarantee, allotment, and scale inversions.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether dispatch should remain audible beside bodily resurrection or only describe the resulting mustering.
Whether notification is chiefly verbal disclosure, formal accusation, experienced verification, or all three in sequence.
Whether the disclose-then-recover arc qualifies the focus generally or only the later faithful case.
The split-root, guarantee, allotment, and small-to-multiplied readings remain analogical activations and must not replace the focus syntax.
